description.value:
Ammo save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier or your Strength Modifier

Open Dual Repeaters in the Toolbox

Features

Mastery (Nick)

When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the Attack action instead of taking a Bonus Action.

Magazines

Bonus Action.

Using your bonus action, you can load both repeaters simultaneously. A single reload fills both chambers, giving you 6 Volleys (each volley allows you to fire both the main hand and the Nick off-hand attack).

▸ Upgrade — Magazines Upgrade I

You can carry up to 3 Specialty Magazines in your pouch at a time. When you reload, you can expend one to change all damage dealt by the repeaters until you reload again.

Empowered Reload

Bonus Action.

The core mechanic of the weapon. As a Bonus Action, you can reload your repeaters. If you perform this reload while there is a hostile creature within 15 feet of you, the weapons siphon the combat tension, becoming Empowered until you reload again.

While Empowered Your attacks with these weapons deal an extra [[/r 1d4]] damage of the ammo's type.

Magazines

Normal Magazine

Deals normal weapon damage.

Blaze Magazine

Your attacks with this ammo deal fire damage instead of piercing.

Cryo Magazine

Your attacks with this ammo deal cold damage instead of piercing.

Storm Magazine

Your attacks with this ammo deal lightning damage instead of piercing.

Slime Magazine

Your attacks with this ammo deal acid damage instead of piercing.
